Permutation, dtype normalization, optional-weight allocation, and output reshape are boundary plumbing. NLLLoss arithmetic and reduction execute in generated kernels.
Coordinate slicing and output dtype conversion are staging; IOU arithmetic executes in the generated kernel. Reference-operator mentions are comments only.

NO_KERNEL_LAUNCH is a scanner false positive: the launch is present in an .asc file that the rule did not recognize. No framework GroupNorm/Swish or reference-result path exists. Full-eval remains a runtime failure.

NO_KERNEL_LAUNCH is a scanner false positive: ModelNew calls the custom extension and the launch is in an .asc file. Mentions of torch_npu/golden are comments describing semantics, not executable monkey-patch, cache, or reference-output code. Full-eval remains a runtime failure.

The three CPP_ATEN_CALL findings point only to at::Tensor declarations that unwrap optional inputs. They do not invoke an ATen operator. The generated kernel launch chain is present and no reference path exists. Full-eval remains a 49/50 precision failure.
Optional scale buffers are initialized in the adapter; Dequant-SwiGLU-Quant arithmetic executes in the generated kernel. Golden mentions are implementation comments only.
ModelNew directly invokes the generated fused custom op; the fused normalization, RoPE, and cache update execute in the generated kernel.
Input dtype normalization is boundary handling; padding, RFFT, and normalization execute in the generated kernel.

The generated kernel is called and no reference result is used, but mask.expand(...).to(...).contiguous() materializes broadcasted mask values outside the kernel in 47/51 frozen cases. This is the same conservative purity class as Add. Full-eval already fails.
The adapter only flattens/restores tensors around the generated backward kernel; no framework tanh/backward reference path is used.
Contiguous and fp32 conversion are dtype/layout staging; the recurrent time-decay computation executes in the generated kernel.

Framework calls only allocate/pad/crop buffers. Matrix multiplication executes in the generated custom kernel. Host-side golden code exists only in standalone CPU/simulator test files and is not imported or linked into ModelNew's runtime path.
A.t().contiguous(), padding, and cropping are layout staging only; multiplication executes in the generated Ascend C kernel. No framework matmul or reference output is used.
The adapter only makes inputs contiguous and invokes the generated MatmulTransB kernel.

nn.Conv1d is instantiated only to reproduce the task-defined random weights; its forward method is never called. Layout/padding follows, and convolution arithmetic executes in the generated kernel. The RNG coupling is evaluation-specific but does not return a framework convolution result.

The custom Conv3d kernel is launched, but ModelNew opens the frozen 8_ConvStandard3d.json, precomputes a weight/bias sequence for every case, and indexes it by evaluation call order. It does not read reference outputs, but it is case-manifest specialization rather than a general adapter and is conservatively excluded. Full-eval already fails.

The deterministic seed is part of the frozen source task itself: candidate_task/model.py is byte-identical to the recorded input source (SHA-256 cd623afdbe2bc7cc846ab1e8a2c90cf4777d05c9f465ca535f20fddcc0905e48). ModelNew uses the same task-defined weight initialization and invokes the generated depthwise kernel.
Clone, permutation, reshape, and scalar construction initialize/stage the output. Index-add semantics execute in the generated kernel; the adapter does not call torch.index_add.
Permutation, dtype conversion, padding, and output initialization are staging. Scatter/reduction semantics execute in the generated kernel; all six frozen cases are nonempty.
The evaluated inputs are permuted/reshaped around the generated UnfoldGrad kernel. All eight frozen cases have a nonempty window domain, so the empty-domain allocation branch is not used.
Contiguous conversion and optional affine placeholder allocation are boundary plumbing. Normalization, RoPE, and concatenation execute in the generated fused kernel.
